text: Listen,{H8085} O isles,{H339} unto me; and hearken,{H7181} ye peoples,{H3816} from far:{H7350} Jehovah{H3068} hath called{H7121} me from the womb;{H990} from the bowels{H4578} of my mother{H517} hath he made mention{H2142} of my name:{H8034}
